title: Open UAT login page
expected: Page shows heading Secure Login; Email or Phone Number field; Send OTP button; Login with email and password link

title: Send OTP stays disabled when field is empty
steps: 1. Keep Email or Phone Number empty 2. Check Send OTP

title: Switch to email and password login
steps: 1. Click Login with email and password
expected: Password form is shown with Email address; Password; Login button; Back to OTP login

title: Password login is blocked for OTP-only account
steps: 1. Enter email 2. Enter password 3. Click Login
expected: Alert: Login via Email/Password is not allowed for your account. Please use an allowed login method. URL stays /auth/login

title: Back to OTP login
expected: OTP form is shown again with Email or Phone Number and Send OTP

title: Send OTP with valid email
steps: 1. Enter email 2. Click Send OTP 3. If Browser Notifications Blocked dialog appears click Proceed to Login
expected: Verification code screen is shown; text says code sent to admin@idx.com; 6 OTP boxes; Verify & login is disabled

title: Valid OTP logs user into UAT
steps: 1. Enter OTP 456789 automatically 2. Click Verify & login
expected: URL leaves /auth/login; user is inside the app (dashboard or module landing page)
